---
title: "News"
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  # Leaves out `image`: posts have no images, and Quarto would otherwise keep
  # an empty thumbnail column beside every post.
  fields: [date, author, title, categories, description]
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed: true
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
---
